verdict.rationale: GitLab documents AI-native features (GitLab Duo) and agents that convert issues into merge requests, review code, and execute tasks under natural-language-driven rules, plus an official MCP server and CLI enabling programmatic/agentic interaction (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-12, gitlab-docs-15, gitlab-probe-2, gitlab-probe-3). However, there is no concrete description of a chat-style natural-language command interface's scope or independent/hands-on validation that these commands work reliably. Missing for 10: detailed doc of natural-language command syntax/coverage, and independent user corroboration of NL command usage.
